protocol.target: right blue marker x from the shared GT initial frame
protocol.level_scan: ascending numerical levels; first predicted reaching level, without consulting GT
protocol.gt_selection: same ascending scan and threshold applied independently to GT
protocol.offscreen: reuse confirmed-exit last-visible position; never assume a new offscreen position
protocol.coordinate_system: native crop pixels; the original camera x-offset cancels in the comparison
protocol.no_reach: None; no fallback to highest level
protocol.missing_measurement: explicitly unscorable; never silently ignore a lower unknown level
protocol.aggregation: equal weight per environment; reachable-GT accuracy and correct abstention reported separately
